title: Harness X-Ray agent fragments
description: The input of scripts/remediate.mjs: agent-fragments.json, optional, in a run folder. The agent proposes fragments for judgment findings only. Each rule must be a judgment rule of the catalog, and remediate.mjs checks the rest: each rule must parse, must hold no secret-shaped value and must name no folder of this machine, and the texts are redacted. The lengths and the counts are capped here.

rule.description: A judgment rule of the catalog: a rule file of kind judgment in rules/.

text.description: What the fragment does and why. It is data: remediation.md and the report escape it.

settings.description: Optional. The settings to copy by hand, with the deny and the ask lists only: a fragment with an allow rule is refused. A fragment with no settings is a text change or a hook, and it is not simulated.
